_doc: Sprite pipeline spec (step 1a). Units are parts lists over a shared rig; build.py turns this into meshes, armatures, actions and renders; pack.py into sheets + manifest. Coordinates: metres, rig rest pose, +X forward, +Y the man's left, Z up. rot = Euler XYZ degrees (about Y: positive tips +Z toward +X). Colours are sRGB 0..1. mat: a fixed colour from 'materials' or a team channel primary / secondary / accent (rendered white in the shade pass, R / G / B in the mask pass). pattern 1 = the part carries the cloth check (mask alpha), shown only by palettes with pattern_k > 0. mirror = also build the .R twin (bones .L <-> .R, y negated).

rome.name: Rome
rome.note: red tunics and shields, gold crests and rims, bronze helmets and plates

carthage.name: Carthage
carthage.note: white linen and shields, Tyrian purple crests and rims, silvered helmets

macedon.name: Macedon
macedon.note: saffron tunics and shields, crimson crests and rims, bronze helmets

epirus.name: Epirus
epirus.note: violet tunics and shields, cream crests and rims, bronze helmets

greeks.name: Greek League
greeks.note: sky blue tunics and shields, white crests and rims, bronze helmets

syracuse.name: Syracuse
syracuse.note: teal tunics and shields, gold crests and rims, silvered helmets

iberians.name: the Iberians
iberians.note: undyed white linen with crimson bands (the check), crimson crests and rims, plain iron

gauls.name: the Gauls
gauls.note: green and blue checked cloaks and saddle cloths, ochre crests, plain iron

humanoid._doc: name, parent, head, tail. Rest pose is the guard stance: both forearms forward (shield hand left, weapon hand right).

heavy_swords.name: Heavy Swords
heavy_swords.look: Roman legionary: big curved rectangular shield, crested helmet with neck guard, short sword, plated shoulders

spearmen.name: Spearmen
spearmen.look: Greek hoplite: big round shield, Corinthian helmet with a tall crest, long spear

pikemen.name: Pikemen
pikemen.look: Macedonian phalangite: the Spearmen model with a smaller shield and a 5.6 m sarissa levelled forward

shock_cavalry.name: Shock Cavalry
shock_cavalry.look: heavy horseman: horse with a faction saddle cloth, crested helmet, round shield, long lance

archers.name: Archers
archers.look: Light bowman: cloth tunic, coloured cap, quiver on the back, bow in the off hand; the attack is a draw and a shot

javelinmen.name: Javelinmen
javelinmen.look: Skirmisher: tunic, leather cap with a coloured band, small round shield, javelins in the off hand and one in the throwing hand

slingers.name: Slingers
slingers.look: Javelinmen's light body: leather cap, no shield, a sling in the right hand (whirled overhead for the shot), a stone bag at the hip

gastraphetes.name: Gastraphetes
gastraphetes.look: Archer's light body braced behind a stocked belly-bow held in both hands

elephant.name: War Elephant
elephant.look: Forest elephant from above: barrel body, thick legs, big ears, trunk curled forward, tusks; a faction caparison and frontlet, a howdah with shields hung on its sides, a driver on the neck and two javelin men behind

camel.name: Camel Riders
camel.look: Dromedary from above: long neck forward, a hump under the saddle cloth; the rider in a turban with a small round shield and a sword

camel_archer.name: Camel Archers
camel_archer.look: The camel with an archer in the saddle: coloured cap, quiver, bow; the attack is the archers' draw and shot from the saddle

crew.name: Engine Crew
crew.look: Javelinmen's light body without weapons: leather cap with a band, a tool pouch; the attack is the work at the winch

bolt_thrower.name: Bolt Thrower
bolt_thrower.look: Torsion bolt thrower on a tripod: a stock with a slide, a frame with two twisted springs and bronze washers, two arms, the string drawn back to the claw, a bolt in the groove, a faction-painted plate between the springs, a winch at the back

scorpion.name: Scorpion
scorpion.look: The bolt thrower at 60 %: on its tripod set up; carried shoulder high by its two men on poles, legs folded

stone_thrower.name: Stone Thrower
stone_thrower.look: Onager: a low frame of two long beams on four small wheels, the horizontal skein with bronze washers, one arm lying back with the sling and a stone, two uprights with a padded faction-coloured buffer, a winch with spokes at the back

cart.name: Hand Cart
cart.look: Two-wheeled hand cart with shafts and a crossbar for the men: a bundle of javelins, arrow sheaves and a basket of sling stones

wagon.name: Ammunition Wagon
wagon.look: Four-wheeled wagon with a pole, a hooped linen cover over the back, bundles of javelins and sheaves of arrows in front

draft_horse.name: Draught Horse
draft_horse.look: The horse without a saddle cloth: a leather collar and harness straps, traces running back to the wagon

atlas._doc: Step 1b: the game's atlas. sets: sprite_set / engine_set ids (unit_types.gd 'sprite_set', 'engine_set'; 0 = procedural) in order from 1, at most 15 (a 4-bit field); props: frames the overlay draws (game/overlay.gd: wagons), not in the shaders' table; palettes: in campaign/cdata.gd FACTIONS order (faction index = palette row).
